info.description: An XYZ map tile service returning PNG tiles with place-name labels for overlaying on a basemap. The API URL format specifies version v1.0.0; this is the API version, not an OpenAPI document version. The existing domain https://mapapi.geodata.gov.hk is scheduled for deprecation on 15 March 2027; the documented current service domain is https://mapapi.hkmapservice.gov.hk. Zoom levels are documented as 8–20 for HK80 and 0–20 for WGS84. Avoid large volumes of requests within a short period. Use is subject to LandsD Map API terms and IP rights notice; the publisher requires attribution (“Map from Lands Department”) and a Lands Department logo on the map face. TLS 1.2 is required. Authentication requirements are not specified in the source.
info.title: LandsD Map Label API

get.description: Returns a map tile under the XYZ tile scheme. The publisher documents PNG output. Version v1.0.0 is currently documented and versions may change; old versions may be removed without notice. Check the official documentation for supported versions.

parameters.description: API version. Currently documented as v1.0.0; may be updated, and old versions may be removed without notice.
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Zoom level under the XYZ tile scheme. The supported range depends on the spatial reference system: 0–20 for WGS84 and 8–20 for HK80.
parameters.name: z

parameters.description: X position of the map tile under the XYZ tile scheme.
parameters.name: x

parameters.description: Y position of the map tile under the XYZ tile scheme.
parameters.name: y

documentedTileRequest.description: The documentation provides this example URL but does not include the PNG response bytes.

200.description: OK. A map tile is returned in PNG format.
